title: Order Delivered Late
brief: The order arrived significantly later than the expected delivery time.

title: Wrong Items Delivered
brief: Received food items that were not part of the order.

title: Missing Items in Order
brief: One or more items from the order were not delivered.

title: Food Quality Issues
brief: The delivered food was stale, spoiled, or not up to the expected quality.

title: Cold Food Delivered
brief: The food was not warm upon delivery and affected the dining experience.
